items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: Prima would be there every Sunday morning. And he could ask questions or he could talk. He made money playing music then. He was a fine boy. And we liked him and we missed him when he wouldn't come around.

ctx.x: Well Louis Prima used to be talking a lot.

Prima. You see now, he was a boy. He used to be around. I don't care where we played. That boy was there. We used to play Highland Baseball part every Sunday morning. Bank of the League. Prima would be there every Sunday morning. And he could ask questions or he could talk. He made money playing music then. He was a fine boy. And we liked him and we missed him when he wouldn't come around. So I asked from him every now and then, but I guess he'd been gun-dated like all the rest of them. Well, it was mighty good.…
A chair? Just like that chair over there? No, but it was round.
